search_log: Listed every AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 0000901832) filing, all form types, via data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000901832.json plus the older page CIK0000901832-submissions-001.json (2,050 filings, 1995-2026; scripts/list_filings.py). Quarterly/half-year/full-year results announcements are furnished on Form 6-K; most H1 results 6-Ks (2018, 2019 and 2021-2026, accession prefix 0001104659) carry only a generic EDGAR description ('6-K' / 'FORM 6-K' / 'FORM 6K') and were identified by opening them, not by description. 69 results documents 2010-02-05 to 2026-07-27 were selected (scripts/catalog.py); the H1 2021 6-K/A (0001104659-21-097940) was not used.

Every document was fetched from sec.gov and flattened to table rows (scripts/rows.py, extract.py). In each results document the product-sales analysis by region prints a year-to-date table (H1/9M/FY) followed by the single-quarter table with a World column; the quarter value is the World column of the single-quarter table (first wide table for Q1 documents, second wide table otherwise), found with a row-label match that tolerates 'Brilinta / Brilique' style labels and a leading dash (scripts/series.py).

Checked every quarter against the same document's year-to-date row (YTD minus previous YTD equals the quarter, tolerance 2) and, for each year with four quarters, the sum of the four quarters against the full-year row of the Q4 document; all agree to within 1 (printed-rounding); no larger difference exists. Checked that the table is the Product Sales table: its total row is 'TOTAL PRODUCT SALES' / 'Total Product Sales' / 'Total Medicines', not Total Revenue.

Q1 2017 results document searched for an Imfinzi product-sales row: none (no row, in any table). First printed row is Q2 2017. Q3 2017 table prints '-' for all columns of the Imfinzi row; written as value 0 with the nil shown as '—' in the quote.

reviewed_anomalies.2017Q3: Printed as a nil (dash) in AstraZeneca's third-quarter 2017 product sales table, after 1 in 2017Q2. Read at source.
